label: D1 after unrewarded trials in the last ~10 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), almost only when the reward input is 0 (99% of mass), and almost only late in the episode (93% of mass at ep_trial 90-99, none before 70), when the value head is low (94% of mass in the lowest value bin). Episode-end + no reward defines it: (D1 & prev_reward==0 & ep_trial>=90) has mass recall 0.92 but precision 0.18. Requiring two unrewarded trials in a row raises precision to 0.36 (dev F1 0.42, mass recall 0.71), and three in a row raises it further, so activation grows with a run of omitted rewards near the end of the episode. Does not fire after rewarded trials or early in the episode. Weak extra lifts that did not hold up as predicates: previous choice a2, upcoming switch (stay==0). Only observed variables are used (ep_trial is a clock the agent can track).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (D1: a2 S2 u, a1 S2 u, ?) and trial before (D1: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, a2 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=9, phase=D1 & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=0.
